about.headline: Bridging Engineering, Product & Business
bio: I am a Technical Product Manager and technology product leader with over 10 years of experience building at the intersection of product strategy, cloud architecture, enterprise software, and AI systems.

Throughout my career—spanning leadership roles at Amazon, Microsoft, and Vertex—I have specialized in one specific challenge: reducing the distance between a high-level business vision and a production-ready technical implementation.

My approach starts with the business and customer problem—not a particular technology. I combine technical fluency in cloud platforms, enterprise software, and AI systems with a product-first mindset focused on measurable business outcomes.

Strongest where technical depth meets product judgment: clarifying ambiguous customer problems, defining rigorous PRDs, prioritizing high-impact trade-offs, and aligning cross-functional teams to deliver on a roadmap.

process.title: How We Work
process.description: A structured, outcome-driven engagement lifecycle designed to move you from uncertainty to a clearly scoped product or technology solution.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.description: We start with an intensive discovery phase to understand your current state, existing data silos, and the underlying business objectives. This involves stakeholder interviews and technical audits of your current stack.

steps.title: Business Problem Assessment
steps.description: We strip away the AI hype to identify the actual problem. We define the 'Job to be Done' and determine if AI is the most effective tool for the solution, or if a simpler architectural change is required.

steps.title: Scope & Proposal
steps.description: I provide a detailed project proposal including a defined scope, target outcomes, timeline, and resource requirements. This ensures total alignment on expectations before any engineering begins.

steps.title: Product Strategy & Technical Planning
steps.description: The core design phase. We create the product roadmap, define the architecture and integration approach, and write the high-fidelity PRDs that engineering teams can execute against.

steps.title: Execution & Implementation Oversight
steps.description: Whether building software, acting as a fractional TPM, or providing advice, I work to keep delivery aligned with the agreed scope. I manage the backlog, resolve technical trade-offs, and conduct rigorous quality evaluations.

steps.title: Evaluation & Handover
steps.description: We measure the results against the initial KPIs. I provide the final documentation, operational guidelines, and a handover plan to ensure your internal team can maintain and scale the system.
